from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial item extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name in this document")
    item_name: str = Field(description="The financial item name as written in the document (e.g., '其他应付款')")
    item_type: str = Field(description="Type of financial item: 'balance_sheet' or 'income_statement' or 'other'")
    period_end_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount at end of period, if available")
    period_begin_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount at beginning of period, if available")
    report_period: str = Field(description="The reporting period this data covers")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency unit as written (e.g., '元', 'Yuan')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_items: list[CompanyFinancialItem]
